title: The Rose in the Rock
working_title: History Before Time: The Rose in the Rock
logline: A fixer who reads made things walks the Siq to a city entirely eaten out of rose sandstone — and learns the wonder is not who carved it but what a people built when they owned the trade road, the rain, and the patience to cut a tomb like a promise.
blueprint: Jakobus-led wonder-of-place — man-made site, grounded not woo; the Nabataean engineering marvel as living heritage (anti-poison pillar); sibling to the quiet backstory volumes but propulsive like the File
market: literary travel-adventure — bucket-list Petra with documentary honesty and the iceberg fixer as guide
